question: Can a complete numeric weight-space Boolean circuit be programmed with no gradient steps from HALF of a 3-bit truth table, when a restrictive affine hypothesis class is explicitly supplied?
hypothesis: For every 3-input affine parity Boolean function (16 coefficient tuples), four public basis observations (000,100,010,001) uniquely determine the complete function, enabling 64/64 held-out correct numeric circuit predictions. An exact GF2 symbolic solver must tie. A structurally indistinguishable out-of-family pairwise interaction must cause 32/64 wrong held-out predictions. No general-Boolean superiority is claimed.
synthetic_generator: Exhaustive coefficient integers 0..15, bit0=bias, bits1..3=three parity coefficients; f(x)=bias XOR XOR_j (coefficient[j] AND x[j]); contexts indexed bit0 least-significant. No randomness or extra witnesses.
implementation: Infer affine coefficients from four basis observations in deterministic Python code, generate a complete inferred truth table, use unchanged WSP-10 DirectCrossbar.from_spec(3,mask) to write task-specific connections from zero; evaluate heldout via numeric threshold sums; zero gradient updates. Inference prior is preprogrammed software, NOT automatically discovered or itself in neural weights.

controls.exact_symbolic: Independent GF2 affine solver receiving the same four outcomes, target 64/64
controls.observed_only: Compile a WSP-10 crossbar with ones ONLY at observed positive contexts, assigning zero to unknown heldouts; target 32/64
controls.full_spec_oracle: Eight labels per world and 64/64 accuracy; UNFAIR information advantage, diagnostics only
controls.ood: Flip labels iff (x0 AND x1), leaving all four observed basis labels intact; 32/64 hidden predictions WRONG is mandatory falsification, with no claim of OOD recovery
controls.ablation: With all programmed synapses zeroed, accuracy is 32/64 on in-family heldouts
controls.tamper: Reject edited snapshots and invalid input types

invariants: No target labels or test contexts passed to the compiler other than the four public contexts and their labels
No gradient training and no external model/API
No per-task truth-table lookup in numeric inference
No post-test changes to hypothesis or thresholds
No output claimed as native novel operator invention
scientific_interpretation: Bounded conditional generalization from an explicitly supplied GF2 hypothesis prior. The exact symbolic solver must tie; no gain in information theory, training energy, compute, independent unfamiliar-world transfer, or general intelligence is established. Scientific superiority remains UNVERIFIED; an OOD counterexample is an expected negative.

qualification_companions: G29 generated atlas artifacts after source freeze
